taskFindings.reason: The twelve already recognised workers, rather than all twenty arrivals, fill the model vacancies. Changed quality, demand, other entries/exits and long-run net outcomes are expressly outside the data. Eight points are correctly allocated2+2+2+2.

Four conditional mechanisms cover a possible benefit and detriment for each country. Source-country remittances can support recipients while skilled-service capacity falls; destination vacancies can fall while delayed recognition can leave qualifications unused or generate transition costs. These are possibilities requiring the stated conditions, not inevitable aggregate welfare conclusions. Rubric four times2 equals8; alternative plausible material-bound interpretations are allowed.

Money40,000 is not healthcare labour; absent information on spending/distribution prevents a compensation assertion. Four intentions are not actual returnees, so current origin capacity remains80. Knowledge transfer needs access, appropriate work and tools; even four actual returns alone do not offset twenty departures. Rubric2+2+2+1 equals7.

One justified response for each country is grounded in recognition/integration and source working conditions/training, with voluntary knowledge exchange allowed. Cost/time/consent and migrant interests remain open, and observable skilled staffing or service access addresses effects more directly than remittance sums. Rubric2+2+1+1+1 equals7; alternative justified responses are equivalent.
